description: Overlay of target-shared-voltage.json (in-sample, not forward-validated): requests unchanged; AVX-512 cores 9–11 required-clock coefficients 0.06 V/100 MHz, thresholds 1.18 V except core 10 at 1.22 V. Cores 9–11 need higher AVX-512 voltage rising more steeply with clock, so core 10 supplies full-load rail support that core 11 loses when core 10 idles.
